fact: The Ethiopian Communications Authority, whose mandate was extended from telecom regulation to data protection, is described as enforcing the law, with its Director General Balcha Reba saying data processors and collectors now need the Authority's permission and that staffing and technical capacity are being expanded (date is the article's published date).
The overview states that the proclamation designates the Ethiopian Communications Authority as the regulator; it does not say the Authority is acting under the law.

Ethiopian News Agency reports that the Ethiopian Communications Authority, under Personal Data Protection Proclamation 1321/2016 EC, held a stakeholder consultation on its implementation, with Director General Balcha Reba saying it protects personal data under its legal mandate.
